G2419.def: Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine

G2443.def: compare G3588 (ὁ)); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result)
G2443.kjv: albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to

G2446.def: the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of Palestine

G2463.derivation: perhaps from G2046 (ἐρέω) (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities);

G2469.derivation: of Hebrew origin (probably H0377 and H07149);

G2470.derivation: probably from G1492 (εἴδω) (through the idea of seeming);

G2495.def: Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two Israelites
